definitions.explanation: Achieving maximum results with minimum waste of time, effort, or resources.

examples.japanese: {効率的|こうりつてき}に⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{効率的|こうりつてき}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧だろう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Isn't there a more efficient way?

examples.japanese: ⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{効率的|こうりつてき}に⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧だ。
examples.english: Using limited time efficiently is the key to success.

notes:
A very common modifier in business, academic, and daily contexts. Formed from ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧ (efficiency) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix making na-adjectives). The base noun ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧ is also frequently used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効率的|こうりつてき}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: an efficient method
- {効率的|こうりつてき}に⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work efficiently
- {効率的|こうりつてき}な⟦{運用|うんよう}→運用：06811_unyou⟧: efficient operation/management
- {効率的|こうりつてき}な⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: efficient way of using

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{能率的|のうりつてき}→能率的：29430_nouritsuteki⟧な: efficient — very similar but slightly more formal and less commonly used
- ⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧な: effective — focuses on achieving good results, not necessarily with minimal waste
- ⟦{合理的|ごうりてき}→合理的：06199_gouriteki⟧な: rational / reasonable — focuses on being logical and well-reasoned
- {生産的|せいさんてき}な: productive — focuses on output and results

USAGE:
The adverbial form {効率的|こうりつてき}に (efficiently) is extremely common in workplace and study contexts. The opposite concept is ⟦{非効率的|ひこうりつてき}→非効率的：27178_hikouritsuteki⟧な (inefficient).
